clips.title: The story
paras: Aku'mai is a monstrous, three-headed hydra dwelling in the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps along the Zoram Strand. A servant of an Old God, it rose from the waters when that Old God's corruption tainted the temple's sacred Moon Well. The Twilight's Hammer cult has gathered in the Deeps and sacrifices innocents to it for power.

Blackfathom Deeps was once a great temple of Elune, until the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted its sacred Moon Well. Aku'mai, a gargantuan hydra and servant of the Old God, rose from the waters. Rather than an ordinary denizen of the tides, Aku'mai is a living blight upon the Zoram Strand that has taken up residence in the submerged ruins of the night elves' fallen temple, poisoning the waters with its malice.
